sentence: This project builds tools and mathematical theories to improve how large generative models are trained and used.
This project builds a network system that brings high-speed Internet to rural farm fields using millimeter-wave communications and deep learning.
This project studies the genomics of plants and photosynthetic microbes using computational biology.
This project builds a system that gathers cyber threat intelligence from Internet traffic to help researchers study Internet threats.
This project studies equations that describe how things like tumor growth and forest fires spread.
This project studies how plants and bacteria choose their partners to fix nitrogen, and how soil and climate shape that choice.
This project builds a soft bioelectronic device that monitors gut biochemical release and gut motion at the same time.
This project expands a field station that protects tallgrass prairie so researchers can study a whole watershed and its ecosystems.
This project builds a small automated instrument that prepares tumor DNA from blood for cancer tests with fewer manual steps.
This project uses artificial intelligence and edge computing to measure how ecosystems exchange carbon, water, and energy with the atmosphere in near real time.
This project builds infrared image detectors from tiny crystals called colloidal quantum dots that could work at room temperature.
This project studies small DNA patterns called k-mers in DNA samples pooled from many individuals of a wild sunflower.
This project sets up a cluster of computers for high-throughput computations in mathematics, statistics, data sciences, and computer sciences courses.
This project studies plastic pollution in coastal areas and looks for ways to detect and clean up plastics.
